title: Leoš Janáček's birth chart
metaDescription: Leoš Janáček's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 11.1° Cancer. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Across the ten placements whose signs are settled, mutable leads with four. The mutable signs sit where one season is already becoming the next — the scheme’s translators.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Measured rather than labelled, the Sun holds 11.1° Cancer: the second decan, whose classical sub-ruler is Mars. A water sign, read here in its second face.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 7.1° Leo; Venus stands at 1.7° Gemini; Mars stands at 26.9° Virgo. The tradition reads a mind that decides at speaking speed from Mercury, taste led by wit and proportion from Venus, drive that grinds rather than flares from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The tightest geometry in the chart puts Uranus a sixth of the circle apart from Neptune, 0.2° off exact. A sixth of the circle is close enough for cooperation and far enough that it stays optional. Behind it, Mars trine Jupiter at 2.7°, and Mercury sextile Saturn at 2.8° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The day-stable angles form no closed figure. Nothing funnels; each aspect is its own negotiation, which the tradition reads as a chart of separate treaties rather than one campaign.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Of the seven planets the classical scheme judges, one sits in a sign it has an opinion about. Jupiter in Capricorn at 24.1° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given. Condition, not character: that is all the dignity table ever measured.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The honest balance sheet uses the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: earth 4, air 3, water 2, fire 1 across the elements, and mutable 4, cardinal 3, fixed 3 across the modalities. Earth weights a chart toward the material and the durable — what can be built, kept, and relied on. Jupiter and Neptune were retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Libra for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.0° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 10.2°.
